package.name: nros_board_linux_aarch64_musl
package.description:
An aarch64 embedded Linux SoC with a musl userland, for nano-ros: the host board's runtime (`nros-board-linux`) cross-built as a static image.
This directory holds the board DESCRIPTOR only, as `packages/boards/linux` does; the Rust crate is `nros-board-linux`. The export below makes the provider discoverable, and the sibling `nros-board.toml` says what it lowers to.
